verifiedArticles.originalTitle: Claude Code on the web で複数リポジトリを接続する：CLAUDE.md・Skillsの挙動
verifiedArticles.timestampEvidence: Original embedded datePublished and publisher RSS agree.
verifiedArticles.accessNote: Full public article text and inline code read. Screenshots and external linked documentation are not independently validated.
facts: Author tested two repositories in A-to-B and B-to-A order, one execution per condition, on Claude Code 2.1.278.
The observed cloud environment set CLAUDE_CODE_ADDITIONAL_DIRECTORIES_CLAUDE_MD=1; both root and .claude/CLAUDE.md instructions were reflected in initial answers and checked output files.
Uniquely named skills from both repositories were callable. The same-named shared-probe chose the first selected repository in the two tested sessions; this is not a guaranteed precedence contract.
verifiedArticles.boundary: Two one-shot conditions cannot establish universal selection priority. Naming skills distinctly and verifying file/PR diffs is an editorial engineering recommendation, not a new benchmark result.
